the commitment protocol, model-checked over every reachable state:

  855 reachable states, 1,247 transitions, over every plan of up to 3 participants
  9 invariants, checked in every one of them

  ✓ NoEffectWithoutAcceptance
      nothing is ever contacted unless a person accepted a guarantee first
  ✓ NoAcceptanceOfRefused
      a plan with no honest guarantee can never be accepted
  ✓ JournalBeforeEffect
      no effect happens whose intent was not written down first
  ✓ IrreversibleIsLast
      nothing irreversible is touched while anything reversible is unsettled
  ✓ AtMostOneIrreversible
      a committable plan never contains two things that cannot be taken back
  ✓ UnwoundMeansNothingIrreversibleRan
      "this did not happen" is never said after something that cannot be undone
  ✓ UnwoundMeansEverythingReversed
      an unwound commitment left nothing standing
  ✓ CommitToolIffUnspentAcceptance
      the commit tool is registered exactly when a person has accepted and not yet spent it
  ✓ RefusedTouchesNothing
      a refusal is computed before contact, so a refused commitment contacted nobody
